integrity: Exact probability and sign identities are analytically proved. Reported critical contrast decimal is numerical; its exact definition and existence are analytical. Direct Gaussian experiments are only finite consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: Two explicitly specified two-product policies, SPD inputs with two distinct spectral levels and trailing multiplicity one or two; no optimality claim among other algorithms or general high-dimensional extension.
title: A multiplicity-driven depth–restart phase diagram for two Gaussian eigenvector probes
